newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving down on selling spree.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving down on selling spree.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange may continue to slide when the market reopens on Saturday after the Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said.
"Investors still believe a persistent banking crisis will hurt the economy and are likely to be mostly eager to offload their shares," said broker Shakil Rizvi.

The market reacted nervously to a warning on Tuesday by central bank chief Lutfar Rahman Sarkar that the country's banking system might collapse over defaulted loans. The DSE all-share price index closed 31.87 points or 3.02 percent down at 1,022.2 on Thursday.
